entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
1.
Heard Mr. Mohd. Naushad, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State-opposite party No.1.
On the matter being taken up, the learned A.G.A. submits that notice of this application under Section 528 BNSS has been served upon first informant-opposite party No.2 on 15.03.2025.

However, in spite of service of notice upon first informant-opposite party No.2 neither any counter affidavit has been filed by the first informant-opposite party No.2 in opposition to this application nor anyone has put in appearance on his behalf to oppose this application even in revised call.

sentences.text:
Applicant-Anas who is a charge-sheeted accused and also facing trial before Court below has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 528 B.N.S.S. with the following prayer :-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this application and quash the impugned Charge-sheet No. 219 of 2024 dated 12.12.2024 and the impugned cognizance/summoning order dated 27.01.2025 passed by the Learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, (POCSO Act), Muzaffarnagar as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 172 of 2025 (State Vs.
Anas) arising out of Case Crime No. 0042 of 2024, Under Section 363, 366, 376 I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station-Charthawal, District Muzaffarnagar pending in the Court of Learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Court), Muzaffarnagar.
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble court may kindly be pleased to stay further proceedings of Case No. 172 of 2025 (State Vs. Anas) arising out of Case Crime No.
0042 of 2024, Under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act,
Police Station- Charthawal, District Muzaffarnagar pending in the court of Learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Court), Muzaffarnagar, during the pendency of the present application before this Hon'ble Court."

entities.text: POCSO Act, Police Station-Charthawal, District Muzaffarnagar
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Court of Learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Court), Muzaffarnagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Court), Muzaffarnagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Upon perusal of record, this Court finds that the High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court Allahabad, The District Legal Services Committee, Muzaffarnagar and the prosecutrix/victim have not been impleaded as party respondents in present application, even though they are necessary and proper parties.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
6. In view of above, learned counsel for the applicant is permitted to file an impleadment application impleading aforesaid authorities as well as the prosecutrix as party respondents/opposite parties in the present application under Section 528 B.N.S.S.
7.
Matter shall accordingly re-appear as fresh on 21.04.2025.
